title: PPLS 2026 at UM
text:
About the Workshop
The Paediatric Perioperative Life Support (PPLS) Workshop is an intensive training program organized by the Malaysian Society of Paediatric Anaesthesiologists (MSPA) in collaboration with Department of Anaesthesiology, Universiti Malaya. This course is designed to enhance the skills of healthcare providers in managing critical events during the perioperative period for children.

title: PPLS 2026 at UM
text:

Date: 13 & 14 June 2026
Time: 7:45 AM – 6:00 PM
Venue: Wad Peperiksaan A, Level 3, Menara Timur, Universiti Malaya Medical Centre
Course Fee: RM400

title: PPLS 2026 at UM
text:
Objectives
The workshop focuses on high-stakes clinical scenarios and practical skill stations, including:

Effective management of perioperative crisis
Perioperative Cardiac Arrest
Crisis Teamwork
Effective Resuscitation
Communication skills


Important Deadlines
Due to the hands-on nature of the training, seats are LIMITED. Please ensure you complete your registration by 13 May 2026.


Contact Personnel
For further inquiries regarding the program, please contact: Dr. Jasmine: +6012-2005753  Dr. Jeremy: +6016-4779066

text:
Getting to UMMC

🚗 By Car
Universiti Malaya Medical Centre is easily accessible via the Federal Highway.

Navigation: Search for “Menara Timur UMMC” on Google Maps or Waze.
Parking:

Menara Timur Carpark (Closest to the venue)
Complex Parkir Bertingkat: Multi-storey parking located near the main hospital entrance.




🚇 By Public Transport (LRT)
The nearest train station is LRT Universiti (Kelana Jaya Line).

Shuttle/Bus: From the LRT station, take the RapidKL bus T789 which stops directly in front of UMMC.
Taxi/Grab: A 5-minute ride from the station to the East Tower (Menara Timur) entrance.
